name: Testimonial Spotlight Carousel
description: A dark testimonial slider on a rounded panel: a centered highlighted card (avatar, name, gold role, quote, brand mark, star rating, folder tab) between dimmed peeking neighbors, with dash pagination that auto-advances and re-centers the active card.
interactions: header + carousel fade up on first view (IntersectionObserver adds .is-inview; wpmn-tsc-up 600ms, carousel staggered 120ms)

one card is active and centered; the track translateX is computed from the active card's offset so it sits mid-viewport, active card scales to 1 and brightens while neighbors dim to .45 and scale .94 (500-600ms cubic-bezier)
auto-advance: setInterval steps to the next testimonial every 5000ms and resets on any interaction
clicking a card or dash, or pressing Enter/Space on a focused card, activates that testimonial
the active dash widens and turns brand-blue
window resize re-centers the active card (120ms debounce)
prefers-reduced-motion: no auto-advance, transitions off, active card shown in place
